notes:
METHOD (2026-10-13): WebSearch/WebFetch plus a Python fetcher that obeys robots.txt (ClaudeBot / Claude-User / anthropic-ai / *). Sites that disallow AI crawlers were not read: ojta.org, olcv.org (OCN page), socan.eco, centraloregonlandwatch.org .ics files, depave.org, aorr.org, environmentamerica.org, phnw.org. Sites returning 403/proxy errors could not be read (birdallianceoregon.org, envirocenter.org, oregonpsr.org, nwenergy.org, newbuildings.org, orbizclimate.org, friendsoftrees.org, thirdact.org, opalpdx.org, pcun.org, crag.org, several city sites, union sites).
COALITIONS: Oregon Conservation Network members come from OLCV's 25 Feb 2025 OCN letter (42 groups); the current list may differ. Oregon Climate Action Hub is an information hub; its "members" here are the 63 groups in its public directory (Oct 2026), not a formal membership. ZERO Coalition: about 18 business members (architecture/engineering/building firms, PGE) left out; the Climate Reality Project logo on its member page is not linked because it does not say which chapter. Energize Bend: 3 business partners and one unidentified logo (COCN) left out. Oregon Just Transition Alliance says it has 20+ member groups but its site blocks automated readers, so no members are linked. Climate Jobs Oregon: NW Labor Press lists 10 early sponsors but says 9 remain after UA Local 290 withdrew; all 10 listed are kept (UA 290 is not among them). PCEF Coalition = the 2018 founding partners named by APANO in June 2026.
LOCATIONS: town centres only (Census 2024 gazetteer), geo_precision "approx". Groups with no Oregon address found are placed at Salem with remote: true. Some towns come from the group's name or its directory region (350 Washington County -> Hillsboro, EOC3 -> Pendleton, Douglas County GWC -> Roseburg, SOCAN -> Ashland): check these.
DROPPED: 350 Corvallis (domain now a casino site), 350 Salem and Oregon Rural Action (sites unreachable), CRAG (blocked). Oregon Climate Equity Network / OCAP coalition looked inactive since 2022.
NOT DONE: OLCV, Sierra Club Oregon, Third Act Oregon, Climate Solutions and OEC event calendars were blocked or empty; 1000 Friends events unreachable. last_activity is blank where no dated 2025-26 activity was seen on the homepage.
